summary.en: Seven small classes that lay out everything between components: `stack`, `cluster`, `auto-grid`, `split-2`, `center`, `measure` and `sr-only`. Reach for them before writing `display: flex` or `grid` by hand.
summary.id: Tujuh kelas kecil yang menata semua hal di antara komponen: `stack`, `cluster`, `auto-grid`, `split-2`, `center`, `measure`, dan `sr-only`. Pakai ini sebelum menulis `display: flex` atau `grid` sendiri.

en.title: Stack and cluster
en.desc: A stack for the column, a cluster for the row of actions that wraps on narrow screens. Spacing comes from `--gap`, never from margins on the children.
